fields.label: PI Item Row
fields.description: Row name of the Purchase Invoice Item this credit note settles.

fields.label: Rebate Due
fields.description: Expected Net Price mechanism -- what the invoice's own Rebate Due says is owed back.

fields.label: Rebate Amount
fields.description: The OTHER rebate mechanism -- the flat 'Add Rebate' amount typed directly on the invoice line. Settled separately from Rebate Due/Actual below, using the two fields that follow.

fields.label: Rebate Amount Received
fields.description: How much of this line's flat Rebate Amount the supplier has actually credited back.

fields.label: Rebate Amount Outstanding
fields.description: Rebate Amount minus Rebate Amount Received, across all Credit Notes against this line.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Expected
Partially Received
Fully Received
Received Above Expected
Cancelled
